name: Saffron Chicken Pilaf
description:
Chicken and grain are cooked with a small but costly pinch of saffron. The golden rice catches the bird's juices without being coloured by magic.

Sold as one individual fine meal. Price and weight cover the named food only; plates, bowls and cutlery remain with the inn. Drinks and unlisted sides are separate. This meal grants no automatic healing or resting bonus.
